title: Wayfare Pass Plan Schedule — Ride-Option Credit Points for Wayfare Green and Wayfare Shared
content:
# Ride-option credit points — Wayfare Pass (rider membership)

When Pass ride credit is posted for a trip of a Wayfare Pass member, the ride-option points are 2 percentage points for a Wayfare Green trip, 1 percentage point for a Wayfare Shared trip and nothing for any other ride option. The points are added to the plan's Pass ride credit rate for that trip.

| Ride option of the trip | Points added to the plan's credit rate |
|---|---|
| Wayfare Green | 2 |
| Wayfare Shared | 1 |
| Wayfare Standard | nothing |
| Wayfare Comfort | nothing |
| Wayfare XL | nothing |
| Wayfare Black | nothing |
| Wayfare Black SUV | nothing |

**Record read.** The ride option of the trip in its trip record in Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares).

**Worked figures (hypothetical).** On Wayfare Pass Annual (credit rate 6 percent), a Wayfare Green trip takes credit at 8 percent and a Wayfare Shared trip at 7 percent; on an eligible fare of 20.00 these give 1.60 and 1.40. A Wayfare XL trip on the same plan stays at 6 percent, 1.20.
